dog.description_text: Roxy just arrived and is still getting settled in, so we’re just beginning to learn who they are. Right now, everything is new—new people, new sounds, new routines—and we’re giving them time to relax, decompress, and show us their true personality at their own pace. Here’s what we know so far from her time in foster care: https://bestfriends.sharepoint.com/:b:/s/GRP_NYC_Foster/IQBD-zshaGfUR5r3vIptOX0uAS0ayTMH3vSZZPuz793gDDY?e=oaBC3d Roxy is a gorgeous 3 year old girl. Her foster says "Over time, she has started coming out of her shell, seeking pets, sitting beside me, and even jumping onto the bed to relax nearby. She is becoming more trusting and comfortable each day, and it has been so rewarding to watch her personality emerge. When Roxy casually jumps onto the bed, grooms herself, and settles down beside me as if she’s always belonged there. Watching her go from being so cautious to comfortably sharing her space with me is adorable. She likes to check out what’s going on, she loves to play with her feather toy, and loves head butting your hand and getting chin and face scritches. She’s friendly, independent, and calm. " Roxy is spayed, vaccinated, microchipped, and has had preventative treatments to ensure she is ready for her next steps.
